name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Bilateral confidentiality agreement for two parties sharing sensitive information, covering mutual obligations, permitted disclosures, and term.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Front-matter and signature block cover page that accompanies the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, capturing party details and effective date.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard SaaS and cloud subscription agreement covering access rights, acceptable use, intellectual property, confidentiality, payment terms, and liability limitations.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-stage or beta product customers who provide feedback, with limited access rights, confidentiality obligations, and feedback IP provisions.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Defines uptime commitments, incident response procedures, service credit calculations, and measurement methodology for cloud and SaaS services.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Covers consulting, implementation, and custom development engagements including statement of work framework, deliverables, IP ownership, change orders, and payment terms.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant data processing addendum covering controller and processor roles, sub-processor management, data subject rights, security measures, and international data transfers.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Reseller, channel, and referral partnership agreement covering partner tiers, co-selling arrangements, revenue share, marketing rights, and program terms.

name: Software License Agreement
description: On-premise or perpetual software licensing agreement covering grant of license, use restrictions, maintenance and support obligations, IP ownership, and warranty terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Time-limited trial and proof-of-concept agreement with defined pilot scope, success criteria, data handling provisions, and conversion terms.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement defining the obligations of a business associate handling Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Contractual addendum addressing AI and ML product usage, data training restrictions, output ownership, bias and fairness obligations, and AI-specific liability.
